chapterInfo.content:
32
Bɔne fakyɛ mu ahotɔ
Dawid deɛ. Nnweneho dwom.
1 # Rom 4.6-9 Nhyira ne deɛ wɔde ne mmarato akyɛ no,
na wɔakata ne bɔne soɔ.
2Nhyira ne onipa a AWURADE mmu n’amumuyɛ ngu ne soɔ,
na nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.
3 # Dwom 31.11; 51.8 Na memuaa m’ano no, me nnompe hodwoe,
m’apinisie a mesii no daa nyinaa nti.
4Na awia ne anadwo wo nsa yɛɛ me so duru,
me mu nsuo twee, na mekusaa sɛ awia berɛ mu.
5 # Mmb 28.13 Mekaa me bɔne mekyerɛɛ wo,
na mankora m’amumuyɛ so.
Mekaa sɛ: Mɛka me mmarato makyerɛ AWURADE.
Wo na wode me bɔne so mmusuo kyɛeɛ.
6Yei nti teeni biara mmɔ wo mpaeɛ da a ɔbɛhu woɔ no.
Ampa ara, sɛ asu kɛseɛ yiri a, ɛremfa ɔyaa korɔ.
7Wone me huntabea,
wobɛbɔ me ho ban na me ho annwan me,
na wode nkwagyeɛ nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.
8 # Dwom 25.12 Na wo AWURADE aka sɛ: Mɛbue w’adwene mu na makyerɛ wo
ɔkwan a wobɛfa soɔ,
m’ani wɔ wo so, na mɛtu wo fo.
9 # Mmb 26.3 Monnyɛ sɛ apɔnkɔ anaa mfunumupɔnkɔ a wɔnnim de,
nnareka ne ɛho homa na wɔde to wɔn ano mu twe wɔn,
anka wɔrentwe mmɛn wo.
10Ɔbɔnefoɔ yea dɔɔso,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no,
wɔde adɔeɛ bɛdi no barehyia.
11 # Dwom 33 Ateneneefoɔ, momma mo ani nnye AWURADE ho, na monni ahurisie!
Akoma mu teefoɔ nyinaa, momfa anigyeɛ nhuro!

pageProps.chapterText:
Nhyira ne deɛ wɔde ne mmarato akyɛ no,
na wɔakata ne bɔne soɔ.
Nhyira ne onipa a AWURADE mmu n’amumuyɛ ngu ne soɔ,
na nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.
Na memuaa m’ano no, me nnompe hodwoe,
m’apinisie a mesii no daa nyinaa nti.
Na awia ne anadwo wo nsa yɛɛ me so duru,
me mu nsuo twee, na mekusaa sɛ awia berɛ mu.
Mekaa me bɔne mekyerɛɛ wo,
na mankora m’amumuyɛ so.
Mekaa sɛ: Mɛka me mmarato makyerɛ AWURADE.
Wo na wode me bɔne so mmusuo kyɛeɛ.
Yei nti teeni biara mmɔ wo mpaeɛ da a ɔbɛhu woɔ no.
Ampa ara, sɛ asu kɛseɛ yiri a, ɛremfa ɔyaa korɔ.
Wone me huntabea,
wobɛbɔ me ho ban na me ho annwan me,
na wode nkwagyeɛ nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.
Na wo AWURADE aka sɛ: Mɛbue w’adwene mu na makyerɛ wo
ɔkwan a wobɛfa soɔ,
m’ani wɔ wo so, na mɛtu wo fo.
Monnyɛ sɛ apɔnkɔ anaa mfunumupɔnkɔ a wɔnnim de,
nnareka ne ɛho homa na wɔde to wɔn ano mu twe wɔn,
anka wɔrentwe mmɛn wo.
Ɔbɔnefoɔ yea dɔɔso,
na deɛ ɔde ne ho to AWURADE soɔ no,
wɔde adɔeɛ bɛdi no barehyia.
Ateneneefoɔ, momma mo ani nnye AWURADE ho, na monni ahurisie!
Akoma mu teefoɔ nyinaa, momfa anigyeɛ nhuro!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
